warnings: Connection details of the steel TRUSS T1 (S-07 view1). Each detail is recorded under its printed callout 'แบบขยาย N' as element_id; the parts are kept verbatim in printed_parts.

Which support each of details 1/2/3 belongs to is read from the callout positions on S-07: ① at the left support (A), ② at the middle support (B, round holes), ③ at the right support (C) on the steel post — location text says so; details 1 and 2 differ only in slotted vs round holes in the top plate.
S-08 names the bottom chord 'ขื่อเหล็ก ⫫ 50x50x3.2มม' — which resolves the unnamed 'เหล็ก ⫫ 50x50x3.2มม' callout on S-07.
The row-C post 'เสาเหล็ก LG ø 3"x3" หรือ ø3"' prints two alternatives (square or round); designation kept as printed (LG) with no dimension keys parsed, flagged.
